03 / PERSONAL BY DESIGN

A local showroom.
A very personal approach.

Founded in 2010 by Sharon Carroll, Weir Interiors grew from a love of fabrics and home decoration into an interior design and refurbishment business.

Our showroom is in the heart of Lucan Village. It’s a place to explore samples, talk through ideas and find the right combination of colours, textures and furnishings for your home.

From choosing a fabric to overseeing a renovation, we offer design advice, sourcing and project management to suit the work you have in mind.

Meet Weir Interiors

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before we begin.

Can you help with just one room?

Yes. The service ranges from a room refresh and new curtains or cushions to full interior design and property refurbishments.

Which areas do you cover?

Weir Interiors is based in Lucan and serves Dublin, Kildare, Meath and Wicklow. The existing website also welcomes enquiries about larger projects elsewhere in Ireland.

Can I see fabrics and samples?

Yes. The Lucan Village showroom has samples and catalogues for fabrics, furnishings and room finishes. Call to discuss your visit.

How do I get a quote?

Contact Weir Interiors to discuss your ideas and arrange a consultation and free quote. The scope and cost will depend on your project.
